convert_skyreelsv2_transformer: convert a SkyReelsV2 transformer model checkpoint to diffusers format using convert_transformer with a model type string
convert_skyreelsv2_vae: convert a Wan2.1 VAE checkpoint to diffusers AutoencoderKLWan format using convert_vae function
run_skyreelsv2_conversion_cli: run the CLI script with --model_type and --output_path arguments to convert SkyReelsV2 models to diffusers format
get_transformer_config: get the diffusers configuration dict for a given SkyReelsV2 model type using get_transformer_config function
load_sharded_safetensors: load and merge sharded safetensor files from a directory into a single state dict using load_sharded_safetensors
